summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed Form 6-K to report FDA Fast Track Designation for givastomig in first-line HER2-negative metastatic gastric cancer. This regulatory milestone accelerates development but does not constitute a special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or capital return. The filing is a routine current report of a corporate development (product pipeline update). No deal terms are present. Category "Other" fits because the filing is not a standard special situation but is a material event outside routine operations.
